evidence.reason: The fixture creates a repository and commits using the ambient Git configuration. It sets only user.email and user.name, so an inherited commit.gpgSign=true can make the baseline commit fail when no signing key is available, and an inherited core.hooksPath can run developer hooks during fixture commits/checkouts. The test should isolate Git config for its temporary repo, for example by setting commit.gpgSign=false and core.hooksPath to an empty fixture directory before the first commit (or by isolating GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL/GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM).
